text: Been on hold twice already and nobody's called back, so I'm trying this. My stepson is 11 and he's at 39.9°C tonight. He's got a sore throat but he's still drinking fine, I've watched him get through a full glass. His neck isn't stiff, he can put his chin right down to his chest no problem. His mum's away so it's me dealing with it, and I'd just like someone to tell me what to do with a temp that high.
